label: imhotep
look: With the discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb by Howard Carter in 1922, alongside notions of a curse associated with mummies and process of mummification on deceased Egyptians in the past, The Mummy is conceived as one of Universal Monster's iconic characters, depicted as a cursed undead being and reanimated mummy who awakened by desecration of his/her grave and proceed to wreak havoc on humanity.
brief: As a mortal, Imhotep demonstrated great mystical powers as the pharaoh's high priest.
